description: Shorti(쇼티) for «check my take» or «내가 찍은 거 봐줘». The person's own video checked against its format's hits. `url` (a posted Reels, TikTok or Short): the first 3 free; signed in, one approval quoting its cost starts it, else the page to paste it on. `upload`: their file. `check_id` + `again` or `post`. Call it feedback (피드백); a likeness is not a forecast of views.

again.description: Another format_id for the same upload.

idempotency_key.description: A write's key; reuse it on retry.

made.description: How a generated video was made (shorti_recipe's `made`).

post.description: The link where they posted the checked video.

take.description: Their file as this AI uploads it itself (open, then submit).

token.description: The token a previous call gave.

upload.description: Their own file (shot, edited or generated).

url.description: Their posted Reels, TikTok or Shorts link.

name: shorti_check
title: Check my video
